title: Unit, Formation, Squad, Fleet & Army Definition Model
objective: Define reusable squad, unit, formation, fleet and army profile projections with explicit membership/composition, capabilities, readiness and equipment/platform references while preserving SCL-01 scale/authority boundaries and canonical constituent truth.
governed_start_requirements: A future owner Continue is required before any application mutation.

Re-read completed SCL-01 plus only the minimum current Character/Creature, D17 Asset/inventory, MIB-14 platform/base, ODL organization/load/delegation, Permission/visibility and validation-core authority needed to resolve exact SCL-02 composition semantics.

Resolve exact profile kinds, membership/reference rules, composition/capability/readiness vocabulary, derivation/provenance, visibility and unknown/conflict behavior at governed start rather than inferring mechanics from the title.

All squads/units/formations/fleets/armies remain identity-preserving projections over canonical constituents/assets; no duplicate Character, inventory, Vehicle, damage, casualty, Organization or Event truth may be created.
Scale membership must preserve explicit canonical constituent ids and must not silently fork identity or double-apply effects.

Command hierarchy/orders remain SCL-03 authority; mechanical resolution remains SCL-04; platform/fleet mechanics remain SCL-08; casualty/damage reconciliation remains SCL-09; strategic consequences remain SCL-10.
AI may advise only where separately governed; SCL-02 selection grants no AI command, order or adjudication authority.
Persistence and migration remain closed at selection; migration 0022 remains unreserved.
Final validation must use exactly one SCL-02 current-family profile with zero historical predecessor fanout and exact-head self-hosted Linux/Windows plus deterministic comparison.
preserved_boundaries: SCL-01 remains completed_verified with implementation authority retired.

SCL-02 is selected only; no unit/profile composition model, readiness semantics, command hierarchy, order, mechanical resolution, casualty/damage mapping or strategic consequence is implemented by selection.
Ordinary Action/Combat/Event truth and all canonical constituent/owner-domain state remain unchanged.
No owner mutation, AI provider invocation, autonomous command/action/system permission, hidden-data reveal, duplicate ledger, durable persistence or migration 0022 is authorized.
SCL-03+, MAL-01+, provider activation, tester distribution, release and deployment remain unauthorized.
